item.title: Synkplay v0.26.0
item.description:
Synkplay 0.26.0 | synkplay-0.26.0-ios
> This release is not on Google Play or the App Store yet.

Changelog since v0.25.0

 - iOS: picture-in-picture now works with AVPlayer and KitePlayer. - A hosted room can now encrypt its connections. Turn on Encrypt connections when you host. When a server's certificate is not trusted by the system, the app shows its fingerprint and lets you decide. - Small drifts between watchers are now corrected with a speed change of half a percent, which nobody notices, instead of a jump. - Headset buttons, the lock screen and the notification no longer pause or seek the whole room by accident. On a TV, the remote's media keys still control the room. - When a connection fails, the app now says why. - Home keeps your five recent rooms under the join key. - KitePlayer is now on 0.2.0. Its audio visualizer studies a linked song in seconds and remembers it, and switching between the visualizer and the video no longer cuts the sound. - The audio visualizer now asks once before it first turns on, because it can flash. Reduce motion also calms it, with no flashes at all. Two patterns that flashed too often on a busy beat were fixed. - ExoPlayer now shows chapters from MKV and MP4 files, and each chapter shows a still frame. - The seek bar shows what is buffered with mpv, KitePlayer and AVPlayer. - An audio or subtitle track that you pick now carries to the next file, by its language. - Subtitle searches now send the episode and the file's hash, for better matches. - Media folders show when the app lost access to them. A playlist file that none of your folders holds is marked, and you can point the app to it. - The hosted server now limits connections and drops a client that floods it. - A chat line or a playlist change can no longer reach the server twice after a reconnect. - Joining from a link, a shortcut or a Quick Action now works at any time. - Screen readers: the room controls stay on screen while a screen reader runs. - Android: you can pick the app's language in the system's per-app language setting. - Android: a baseline profile makes the app start faster. - About now lists the open source licences, and its panel is liquid glass. - iOS VLC: updated to VLCKit 4.0.0a24. - The log now hides identifying details and limits its size. - Notices now fade in and out. - Small fixes for Android TV focus, the picture-in-picture offer, mpv volume and ExoPlayer subtitles.
## Translations   Help translate Synkplay on [Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/syncplay-mobile/).

item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v5.0.7
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.7 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **library**: Filter tracks missing verified ReplayGain tags - **library**: Pause and resume library scans - **backend**: Hold library scans in place while paused - **library**: Select search results with a long press - **metadata**: Add a primary artist tag mode - **metadata**: Write primary-artist tags in native writers - **album**: Replace selection sharing with metadata re-enrichment - **appearance**: Add glass clarity controls and directional highlights - **lyrics**: Keep the screen awake while viewing lyrics
### Bug Fixes
- **download**: Stop crashing native finalization on Android regex - **backup**: Restore download and metadata provider order - **background**: Keep library scans and update downloads running with the screen off - **mornye**: Preserve navbar blur during collapse animations - **mornye**: Soften glass rims and increase transparency - **mornye**: Respect glass clarity and accessibility limits - **library**: Spread filters across the search field width - **library**: Offer re-enrichment for downloaded selections - **lyrics**: Lift timed words together - **storage**: Retain document access for library metadata and covers - **startup**: Keep shared backend alive across activity recreation - **download**: Verify ReplayGain tags independently of metadata embedding - **metadata**: Preserve the selected recording during download enrichment - **library**: Preserve partial scans and ignore stale completion events - **library**: Open track metadata from search results
### Performance
- **mornye**: Share chrome backdrops and scale blur to clarity - **store**: Skip invisible backdrop blur on repo cards - **library**: Trim scan ingestion writes - **library**: Stat each walked entry once - **library**: Overlap SAF listings and metadata reads - **mornye**: Adapt glass and player effects to device capabilities - **player**: Suspend covered pages and streamline transitions - **download**: Avoid repeated progress decoding and queue regrouping - **download**: Reuse connections across probes and retries - **library**: Reduce scan allocations and keep SAF workers busy - **library**: Reuse bounded artwork thumbnails during scans
### Refactoring
- **library**: Share the track selection bar and delete action - **backend**: Retire unused native bridge entry points - **download**: Simplify finalization and remove the retired worker - **flutter**: Remove unreachable state and widget APIs - **library**: Remove unused history lookups and replacement paths - **ui**: Consolidate file feedback and shared display helpers
### Testing
- **library**: Keep notifier test counters private
### Chores
- Update AltStore source to v5.0.7 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]) - Update AltStore source to v5.0.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot]) - **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.7
### Build
- **android**: Reduce compat media deprecation warning noise - **android**: Sign release APKs with APK Signature Scheme v4
**Full Changelog**: [v5.0.6...v5.0.7](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v5.0.6...v5.0.7)
---
### Downloads
#### Android - **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices) - **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-arm32.apk` (older devices) - `*.apk.idsig`: V4 signatures for `adb install --incremental` only; normal installs do not need them
#### iOS - **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.7-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)
### Installation **Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK **iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA

item.title: Apollo v3.8.5
item.description:
Apollo 3.8.5 | Apollo-Reborn-3.8.5
### Features
- Add **Google Search** to the Search tab: tap the magnifier and pick Google to find Reddit threads through Google, with its snippets, Any Time and Exact Words filters, and results that open natively in Apollo (#1260: @icpryde) - Open the fullscreen image viewer's **Copy / Save / Share** menu where you press and hold, instead of the middle of the screen (#1254: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Add **Toon Bot** and **Happy Toon Bot** to the Concepts icon pack (#1253: @IllIIllIllIllII)
### Performance
- Make Apollo lighter on memory and quicker to launch: image caches now have size limits and are freed when iOS runs low on memory, the Deleted Comments and sidebar text hooks stay idle when they aren't needed, editing a comment no longer holds up other loads for up to 20 seconds, and launch does less work (#1169: @paradoxally, @icpryde) - Also stops the comments title flashing on non-Liquid-Glass builds, and makes **Remember Post Sort** open posts from links, the inbox, or Floating Post Tabs in your saved sort straight away instead of reloading them - Stop the **AI comment summary** from re-running over and over while you scroll a thread (#1270: @Thetromboneman1) - Stop filtered posts leaving stacks of gray gaps in feeds, correcting just the affected rows instead of redrawing the whole feed (#1274: @Thetromboneman1)
### Fixes
- Fix a feed **crash** when several RedGIFs posts load at once, most often right after launching or switching accounts (#1251: @icpryde) - Fix a crash tapping "Translated from…" on a recovered **deleted comment** (#1222: @icpryde) - Fix **RedGIFs** posts showing "RedGIFs error" on every post after switching Wi-Fi, cellular, or VPN, and on older RedGIFs videos with no listed length (#1256, #1258: @icpryde) - Fix **API-Key-Free** feeds getting stuck on a spinner: avatar lookups no longer use up Reddit's request limit for your session (#1220: @icpryde) - Keep avatar and subreddit lookups on the active account, so avatars stop staying blank and follow and subscribe states are right when you have several accounts signed in (#1227: @icpryde) - Fix **Add Account** signing in with the active account's saved API key instead of the one set in Settings (#1237: @icpryde) - Explain what went wrong when Reddit rejects your API key during sign-in, instead of leaving a blank "{}" page (#1236: @icpryde) - Fix **Invalid Backup** when restoring backups made on 3.7.x and earlier (#1217: @icpryde) - Fix **Unmute Videos** swapping the sound between two playing feed videos on every frame, starting videos with sound from feeds you already left, and playing on with sound under a different fullscreen video (#1247, #1250, #1252: @icpryde) - Fix a post's video going grey, and the video scrubber not working, after opening the OP's profile or swiping forward back into the post (#1269: @icpryde) - Fix **Swipe Past Gallery to Navigate** only acting after you lift your finger, sometimes on the wrong thread: swiping past a feed gallery's first or last image now goes straight to your post swipes (vote, save, back, or forward) (#1271: @Thetromboneman1) - Fix tapping a post sometimes opening a gallery post from further up the feed with **Swipe Through Feed Galleries** on (#1248: @icpryde) - Fix **Gallery View** only playing the first video when swiping on CarPlay (CarBridge/CarCast) (#1257: @icpryde) - Fix **Download Video** sending the first video you shared again over Messages, and clean up the downloaded copies it left behind (#1216, #1219: @icpryde) - Reserve room for **inline comment images** up front, so comments no longer grow when the image finishes loading (#1273: @Thetromboneman1) - Explain why a **comment** couldn't post, such as the post being removed (and where the mods' reason is), the thread being locked or archived, the parent comment being removed, or a ban, instead of "Reddit had a little hiccup" (#1275: @icpryde) - Fix a just-posted **image comment** showing "[Unknown Image]" under the picture (#1246: @icpryde) - Keep the newest message above the reply bar in **modmail** and message threads on iOS 26 and 27, and bring the reply bar back after a cancelled swipe-back between threads (#1228, #1234: @icpryde) - Fix the **post composer**'s Post button turning white on Liquid Glass, the Media body editor's checkmark turning into Post as you type, and Command-Return submitting from the body editors instead of acting as Done (#1221, #1226, #1233: @icpryde) - On Liquid Glass, keep a scrolled-away feed **search bar** hidden after swiping back from a post, and the Search tab's placeholder dim after Cancel (#1249, #1261: @icpryde) - Fix **interactive posts**' Subscribe button doing nothing when Reddit needs your permission first, and keep Apollo's Join button and Subscriptions list in sync when a post subscribes you (#1264: @icpryde) - Put the post header's **translation** marker after the edited pencil instead of on top of it (#1259: @icpryde) - Keep feed avatars out of post titles that name their own author (#1218: @icpryde) - Show old-reddit sprite **user flairs** on every row of the flair picker again (#1215: @icpryde) - Stop **Random** and **RandNSFW** sometimes opening an empty feed that never loads (#1272: @Thetromboneman1) - Fix tapping a multireddit's expand arrow in the Subreddits list asking to change a favorite, and style expanded multireddit rows like the rest of the list (#1229: @nunoo) - Fix the Subreddits list's **Edit** mode putting moderator hide controls on the wrong rows and jumping the list up after Edit or Done (#1262: @icpryde) - Swiping a row no longer turns on Edit controls, and stars stay put in Edit mode with Subreddit List Enhancements off - Open the multireddit editor in the Subreddits list's Edit mode again when Multireddits isn't the second section (#1267: @icpryde) - Make **settings section headers** match across Apollo's and Apollo Reborn's settings on iOS 26 and later, in one Title Case style that follows Text Size and your theme (#1241: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix **Settings Shortcuts**' Remove button not removing the shortcut (#1212: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make **Pixel Pals** follow the real Dynamic Island on iPhone 18 Pro and newer (#1244: @JeffreyCA) - Fix **Open in Apollo (Legacy)** in Safari doing nothing without Link Companion installed (#1268: @Thetromboneman1) - Stop the **Social Links** row sometimes showing Reddit's copyright footer instead of a profile's links (#1231: @icpryde) - Stop forwarding Apollo's analytics to your **Notification Backend** when one is set; they're now always blocked (#1230: @DeltAndy123)

item.title: SpotiFLAC Mobile v5.0.6
item.description:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.6 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.6-ios-unsigned
### New Features
- **player**: Show covers and expressive controls in Material queue - **material**: Unify search filters and extension actions - **player**: Show Material lyrics in the artwork area - **player**: Animate Material seek bar with expressive waves - **material**: Adopt expressive controls across the app - **album**: Zoom artwork when pulling down the Mornye header - **settings**: Give playback its own settings page - **player**: Add AAudio hi-res, WavPack DSD and DAC volume - **player**: Add direct USB audio and DSD transport - **player**: Add verified USB bit-perfect PCM output - **player**: Continue playback with Library autoplay - **appearance**: Add an optional system font - **mornye**: Add persistent accent color choices - **lyrics**: Group smaller backing vocals beneath their lead - **player**: Expand artwork when tapping the compact cover - **player**: Swipe track headers and remove individual queue entries - **library**: Search songs albums artists and playlists by relevance - **album**: Display disc groups from catalog metadata - **lyrics**: Support multiple vocalists and aligned lyrics
### Bug Fixes
- **download**: Align native metadata preparation and ReplayGain support - **library**: Index native completions and refresh background downloads - **library**: Preserve indexed tracks when a full scan is incomplete - **download**: Detect mislabeled MP4 before native metadata writes - **motion**: Pause loading effects when hidden or motion is reduced - **metadata**: Resolve album artist consistently across separate downloads - **settings**: Use neutral category icons in Material - **material**: Keep navigation tint continuous through system inset - **player**: Move Material audio output to bottom right - **player**: Align Material lyrics toggle to bottom left - **player**: Give Material quality badge and controls more space - **album**: Show Material quality badges only for exceptions - **ui**: Show Dolby Atmos as a compact logo - **queue**: Style Mornye swipe removal and simplify queue heading - **album**: Remove dividers above Mornye disc headings - **library**: Replace library badge text with a folder icon - **player**: Distinguish AAudio access and decoder failures - **lyrics**: Keep V3 collaborations on the primary side - **lyrics**: Reveal backing vocals and gaps at their start - **lyrics**: Preserve group alignment in eLRC fallback - **mornye**: Improve frosted menu contrast and readability - **mornye**: Keep popover glass clear and correctly clipped - **mornye**: Use translucent liquid glass for action menus - **mornye**: Preserve contrast with custom accent colors - **settings**: Restore distinct category icons on the main page - **player**: Align lyrics and compact header with timeline - **lyrics**: Preserve Apple vocal sides for group parts - **ios**: Scan app documents without the Files folder picker - **artist**: Restore artwork accents with neutral portrait fallback - **player**: Separate adjacent titles during track swipes - **player**: Swipe left to advance and right to return - **player**: Retain duration probing after queue edits during loading - **lyrics**: Stagger highlight lift across graphemes - **artist**: Use white Mornye header actions regardless of artwork color - **player**: Keep shuffle order stable and restore the original queue - **lyrics**: Keep the active line anchored during language transitions - **player**: Serialize source changes during rapid track selection - **album**: Show More only for truncated descriptions - **artist**: Zoom artwork during pull-down stretching - **navigation**: Preserve compact state and active icon colors - **updater**: Revalidate releases instead of hiding updates in cache - **metadata**: Clarify online autofill controls
### Performance

### Styling
- **playback**: Mark bit-perfect and DAP hi-res output as beta - **library**: Use theme colors for Material collections

item.title: Nebulo v3.0.0
item.description:
Nebulo 3.0.0 | OnsideTV_V3.0.0
### **Nebulo is now Onside TV!** Same app, new name, and the biggest update so far.
### **Read this before you install** - **You need iOS 26 or newer.** If your phone is on an older version, stay on Nebulo V2.3 for now. - **Onside TV installs as a new app next to Nebulo.** You'll have to log in again, and your favorites and settings from Nebulo won't carry over. Once you're set up you can delete Nebulo. - **There's just one IPA this time**, no backup version.
### **What's New** - **New look:** Liquid Glass all through the app, a new home screen with big channel cards and a full screen hero at the top. - **Way bigger sports section:** Game cards with lineups, stats, momentum, shot maps, win probability and box scores, plus standings, team pages and schedules. - **Favorite teams:** Follow your teams, leagues, drivers and golfers and see their next game or live score on the home screen. - **Live Activities:** Follow the score from your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. - **Smarter game search:** Tap a game and the app checks your TV guide for both teams around the start time, then plays the right channel or shows you the best matches. - **New search:** Live games, recently watched channels and your categories all in one place. - **Recordings:** Stop, delete or jump to the live channel right from the recordings section, and recordings now show their own guide info. - **Connection warning:** If your provider only gives you one connection, the app warns you before watching something else would cut off a recording.
### **Fixes** - If your login is wrong the app now tells you, instead of dropping you on an empty home screen. The guide also loads right away the first time you log in. - Streams don't keep playing sound anymore after you close them and lock your phone. - Smoother scrolling and less heat. - Show pictures on the home screen only appear when they actually match the show.
### **Under the Hood** - The code is open source now under the MIT license. - Update checks still come from GitHub, so you'll get a heads up in Settings when a new version is out.
Questions or bugs? Come say hi in the [Discord](https://discord.gg/msq2tcd5Rg) or [open an issue](https://github.com/mongoosemonke504/OnsideTV/issues).

item.title: Chan v1.2.9
item.description:
Chan 1.2.9 | Chance
## New Features
- New captcha cloud solver - Small redesign of captcha form - Support image pasting from keyboard on iOS 27 - Rename saved attachments
## General Improvements
- Reddit comments replaced by "Edit: comment has been cleaned" will retain their previous text - Many QUIC and HTTP/3 bugfixes and performance improvements
## Tweaks
- Don't insert duplicate quotelinks when using "reply" to open the reply form - Added a confirmation before clearing cookies when banned - Hide archive name when scrolling to bottom of thread (it's already there) - Always restart videos from beginning in gallery - Slight tweak of tab bar resizing for long tab titles
## Bugfixes
- Threads not marked as archived - Gallery changed image when rotating the device - Compatibility error on some newer Android versions - Unable to tap tabs on first page sometimes - Intermittent errors about directories not existing - YouTube shorts embeds not shown - Posting multiple files on lynxchan-based sites didn't work and just combined their filenames - Thread tail requests were not properly optimized for caching - Cloudflare popup trying to load Twitter embed data - Backspacing an embeddable URL in the reply box would cause repeated network requests - Tab bar spazzed open and close when slowly scrolling to the bottom of a thread

item.title: Reynard v0.15.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.15.0 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.14.1...0.15.0
### New Features - Added support for printing a webpage or an online PDF viewed in the browser, accessible as a **Print** option in the share sheet or with the Command + P keyboard shortcut. - You can now see which tab is playing audio and mute tabs directly from the address bar. - You can now configure whether Reader Mode is shown automatically for a specific website or for all websites. - Built-in add-on pages, such as those that provide a custom new tab appearance, can now be set as your new tab page. - For links that open in a new tab automatically or from the context menu, you can now return to the opener tab using the back button, or by swiping from the left edge of the screen to the right.
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - JIT can now be enabled on iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. - Greatly reduced memory and power usage when the camera is active. - The Command + W keyboard shortcut now activates the adjacent tab instead of the most recently opened one. - If you set the last tab to show on startup, the browser now loads its URL immediately instead of after a short delay. - The list of recently closed tabs now clears when you remove browsing history in the browser settings. - Fixed a regression where Reader Mode’s serif font would be used as the default serif font for all websites. - Fixed numerous bugs and improved UI animations.
### Translations Added Vietnamese translation.
### Engine Updated Gecko to [156.0.1](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_156_0_1_RELEASE) (released Sep 22, 2026).
